info.title: PiAPI/FaceSwap Universal API
info.description: Create image, multi-face, and video face-swap tasks on PiAPI and track PiAPI task status through the provider's unified task and account endpoints.

get.description: Retrieves user task history from PiAPI/FaceSwap.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of history records per page, max 100.

schema.description: Number of history records per page, max 100.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Optional PiAPI model filter such as image_toolkit or video_toolkit.

schema.description: Optional PiAPI model filter such as image_toolkit or video_toolkit.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Unix timestamp in seconds for the earliest history entry to include.

schema.description: Unix timestamp in seconds for the earliest history entry to include.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Unix timestamp in seconds for the latest history entry to include.

schema.description: Unix timestamp in seconds for the latest history entry to include.
